name: Ariel - Ethereal Voice
en:
Boost 1 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
1 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
COMMAND PERFORMANCE Once during your turn,
whenever you play a song, if there's a card under
this character, you may draw a card.
zh:
增幅 1 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
命令演出　你回合中一次，每當你打出一首歌時，若這個角色下方有卡，你可以抽一張牌。

en:
Boost 3 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 3 ⬡ to put
the top card of your deck facedown under this character.)
TIMELY ALLIANCE Whenever you put a card under this

a character card, you may play that character for free and

增幅 3 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）

zh:
變身 2 ⬡（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 The Horned King 的角色上。）

備用計畫　當你打出這個角色時，抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

your hand.

name: Magica De Spell - Conniving Sorceress
en:
Shift 7 ⬡ (You may pay 7 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Magica De Spell.)
SHADOW'S GRASP When you play this
character, if you used Shift to play her, you may
draw 4 cards.
zh:
變身 7 ⬡（你可以支付 7 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Magica De Spell 的角色上。）
暗影之握　當你打出這個角色時，若你以變身打出她，你可以抽 4 張牌。

name: Demona - Scourge of the Wyvern Clan
en:
AD SAXUM COMMUTATE When you play this
character, exert all opposing characters. Then,
each player with fewer than 3 cards in their hand
draws until they have 3.
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your
hand, this character can't ready.
zh:
AD SAXUM COMMUTATE　當你打出這個角色時，橫置所有對方角色。然後，每位手牌少於 3 張的玩家抽牌直到手牌有 3 張。
白日化石　若你手上有 3 張或以上的卡，這個角色不能準備。

name: Hades - Looking for a Deal
en:
WHAT D'YA SAY? When you play this character, you may
choose an opposing character. If you do, draw 2 cards
unless that character's player puts that card on the
bottom of their deck.
zh: 你說呢？　當你打出這個角色時，你可以選擇一個對方角色。若你這麼做，抽兩張牌，除非該角色的持有者將該卡放到其牌庫底。

name: Olaf - Helping Hand
en:
SECOND CHANCE When this character leaves
play, you may return chosen character of yours to
your hand.
zh: 第二次機會　當這個角色離場時，你可以將你一個指定角色移回你的手牌。

name: Merlin - Completing His Research
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
LEGACY OF LEARNING When this character is banished
in a challenge, if he had a card under him, draw 2 cards.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
學習的傳承　當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，若他下方有卡，抽兩張牌。

name: Ursula - Whisper of Vanessa
en:
Boost 1 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
1 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
SLIPPERY SPELL While there's a card under this
character, she gets +1 ◊ and gains Evasive. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh:
增幅 1 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
滑溜咒語　當這個角色下方有卡時，她獲得 +1 ◊ 並獲得迴避。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Cheshire Cat - Inexplicable
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
IT'S LOADS OF FUN Whenever you put a card under this
character, you may move up to 2 damage counters from
chosen character to chosen opposing character.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
超級好玩　每當你把一張卡放到這個角色下方時，你可以將至多 2 個傷害指示物從指定角色移到指定的對方角色。

name: Begone!
en:
Return chosen character, item, or location with cost 3
or less to their player's hand.
zh: 將一個費用 3 或以下的指定角色、物品或地點移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Can't Hold It Back Anymore
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Exert chosen opposing character. Move all damage
counters from all other characters to that character.
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
橫置指定的對方角色。將所有其他角色身上的傷害指示物移到該角色。

name: Swooping Strike
en:
Each opponent chooses and exerts one of their ready
characters.
zh: 每位對手選擇並橫置其一個已準備的角色。

name: Performance Review
en:
⟳ chosen ready character of yours to draw cards equal
to that character's ◊.
zh: 橫置你一個指定的已準備角色，抽取等同該角色 ◊ 數量的牌。

name: Fragile as a Flower
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Draw a card. Exert chosen character with cost 2 or
less. They can't ready at the start of their next turn.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
抽一張牌。橫置一個費用 2 或以下的指定角色。他們在其下個回合開始時不能準備。

name: Junior Woodchuck Guidebook
en:
THE BOOK KNOWS EVERYTHING ⟳, 1 ⬡, Banish this
item — Draw 2 cards.
zh: 這本書無所不知　⟳，1 ⬡，消滅這個物品 — 抽兩張牌。

name: Grimorum Arcanorum
en:
DOCTRINA ADDUCERE During your turn, whenever an
opposing character becomes exerted, gain 1 lore.
CELERITAS Your characters named Demona gain Rush.
(They can challenge the turn they're played.)
zh:
DOCTRINA ADDUCERE　在你的回合中，每當有對方角色橫置時，獲得 1 點傳說值。
CELERITAS　你名為 Demona 的角色獲得突襲。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

name: The Great Illuminary - Abandoned Laboratory
en: STARTLING DISCOVERY Characters gain “⟳ — Draw a card” while here.
zh: 驚人的發現　角色在這裡時獲得「⟳ — 抽一張牌」。

name: Flotsam - Slippery as an Eel
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Kaa - Suspicious Serpent
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
zh: 守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）

name: Webby Vanderquack - Mystery Enthusiast
en:
CONTAGIOUS ENERGY When you play this
character, chosen character gets +1 ¤ this turn.
zh: 感染的活力　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色本回合獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Finnick - Tiny Terror
en:
YOU BETTER RUN When you play this character,
you may pay 2 ⬡ to return chosen opposing
character with 2 ¤ or less to their player's hand.
zh: 你最好快跑　當你打出這個角色時，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將一個 2 ¤ 或以下的指定對方角色移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Vladimir - Ceramic Unicorn Fan
en:
HIGH STANDARDS Whenever this character
quests, you may banish chosen item.
zh: 高標準　每當這個角色探險時，你可以消滅指定的物品。

name: Flintheart Glomgold - Scheming Billionaire
en:
TRY ME While you have a character or location in
play with a card under them, this character gains
Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to
challenge.)
zh: 試試看　當你有一個下方有卡的角色或地點在場時，這個角色獲得守護。（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。）

name: Jetsam - Opportunistic Eel
en:
AMBUSH FROM THE DEEP When you play this
character, deal 3 damage to chosen opposing
damaged character.
zh: 深海伏擊　當你打出這個角色時，對指定的受傷對方角色造成 3 點傷害。

name: Kaa - Secretive Snake
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Emily Quackfaster - Level-Headed Librarian
en:
RECOMMENDED READING When you play this
character, you may put the top card of your deck
facedown under one of your characters or locations
with Boost.
zh: 推薦讀物　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到你一個具增幅的角色或地點下方。

name: Flynn Rider - Spectral Scoundrel
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
2 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
I'LL TAKE THAT While there's a card under this
character, he gets +2 ¤ and +1 ◊.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
那我拿走了　當這個角色下方有卡時，他獲得 +2 ¤ 和 +1 ◊。

name: Bellwether - Master Manipulator
en:
VENDETTA When this character is challenged
and banished, put 1 damage counter on each
opposing character.
zh: 宿怨　當這個角色被挑戰並消滅時，在每個對方角色上放置 1 個傷害指示物。

name: Launchpad - Exceptional Pilot
en:
OFF THE MAP When you play this character, you
may banish chosen location.
zh: 脫離地圖　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅指定的地點。

name: Baloo - Carefree Bear
en:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Baloo.)
ROLL WITH IT When you play this character,
choose one:
• Each player draws a card.
• Each player chooses and discards a card.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Baloo 的角色上。）
隨遇而安　當你打出這個角色時，選擇一項：
• 每位玩家抽一張牌。
• 每位玩家選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Megara - Secret Keeper
en:
Boost 1 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 1 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
I'LL BE FINE While there's a card under this
character, she gets +1 ◊ and gains “Whenever this
character is challenged, each opponent chooses and
discards a card.”
zh:
增幅 1 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
我會沒事的　當這個角色下方有卡時，她獲得 +1 ◊ 並獲得「每當這個角色被挑戰時，每位對手選擇並棄掉一張卡」。

name: Goldie O'Gilt - Cunning Prospector
en:
CLAIM JUMPER When you play this character,
chosen opponent reveals their hand and discards
a location card of your choice.
STRIKE GOLD Whenever this character quests,
you may put a location card from chosen player's
discard on the bottom of their deck to gain 1 lore.
zh:
搶占礦權　當你打出這個角色時，指定對手展示其手牌並棄掉一張你選擇的地點卡。
挖到金礦　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將一張地點卡從指定玩家的棄牌堆放到其牌庫底，來獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Shere Khan - Fearsome Tiger
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
ON THE HUNT Whenever this character quests,
banish chosen opposing damaged character.
Then, you may put 1 damage counter on another
chosen character.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
狩獵中　每當這個角色探險時，消滅指定的受傷對方角色。然後，你可以在另一個指定角色上放置 1 個傷害指示物。

name: Scrooge McDuck - S.H.U.S.H. Agent
en:
BACKUP PLAN When you play this character, draw
a card, then choose and discard a card.
ON THE MOVE When this character is challenged,
return this card to your hand. (No damage is dealt
in that challenge.)
zh:
備用計畫　當你打出這個角色時，抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。
移動中　當這個角色被挑戰時，將這張卡移回你的手牌。（該次挑戰不造成傷害。）

name: Akela - Forest Runner
en:
AHEAD OF THE PACK 1 ⬡ — This character gets
+1 ¤ this turn.
zh: 領先群體　1 ⬡ — 這個角色本回合獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Goofy - Emerald Champion
en:
EVEN THE SCORE Whenever one of your other
Emerald characters is challenged and banished,
banish the challenging character.
PROVIDE COVER Your other Emerald characters
gain Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except
to challenge.)
zh:
扳平比分　每當你另一個翡翠角色被挑戰並消滅時，消滅進行挑戰的角色。
提供掩護　你其他的翡翠角色獲得守護。（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。）

name: Little John - Impermanent Outlaw
en:
Boost 3 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
3 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
READY TO RASSLE Whenever you put a card under
this character, ready him.
zh:
增幅 3 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
準備摔角　每當你把一張卡放到這個角色下方時，準備他。

name: Webby Vanderquack - Junior Prospector
en:
Shift 2 ⬡ (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Webby Vanderquack.)
Ward
WORK SMARTER Whenever this character quests, if an
opponent has more cards in their inkwell than you, you may
put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.
zh:
變身 2 ⬡（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Webby Vanderquack 的角色上。）
守護
聰明工作　每當這個角色探險時，若對手墨水池中的卡比你多，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: So Be It!
en:
Each of your characters gets +1 ¤ this turn. You may
banish chosen item.
zh: 你每個角色本回合獲得 +1 ¤。你可以消滅指定的物品。

name: Trust In Me
en:
(A character with cost 6 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Choose one:
• Each opposing character gets -1 ◊ until the start of
your next turn.
• Each opponent chooses and discards 2 cards.
zh:
（費用 6 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
選擇一項：
• 每個對方角色獲得 -1 ◊，直到你的下個回合開始。
• 每位對手選擇並棄掉 2 張卡。

name: Chomp!
en: Deal 2 damage to chosen damaged character.
zh: 對指定的受傷角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Malicious, Mean, and Scary
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Put 1 damage counter on each opposing character.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
在每個對方角色上放置 1 個傷害指示物。

name: Potion of Malice
en:
SUPPRESSED ANGER ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Put 1 damage counter
on chosen character.
MINDLESS RAGE ⟳, Banish this item — Each opposing
damaged character gains Reckless until the start of
your next turn. (They can't quest and must challenge
if able.)
zh:
壓抑的憤怒　⟳，1 ⬡ — 在指定角色上放置 1 個傷害指示物。
盲目狂怒　⟳，消滅這個物品 — 每個受傷的對方角色獲得魯莽，直到你的下個回合開始。（他們不能探險，且若有能力必須挑戰。）

name: Inscrutable Map
en:
BACKTRACK ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen opposing character
gets -1 ◊ until the start of your next turn.
zh: 回溯　⟳，1 ⬡ — 指定的對方角色獲得 -1 ◊，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Enigmatic Inkcaster
en:
ITS OWN REWARD ⟳ — If you've played 2 or more cards
this turn, gain 1 lore.
zh: 自身的回報　⟳ — 若你本回合打出過 2 張或以上的卡，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Blessed Bagpipes
en:
MCDUCK HEIRLOOM When you play this item, you may
put the top card of your deck facedown under one of
your characters or locations with Boost.
BATTLE ANTHEM Whenever one of your characters
or locations with a card under them is challenged,
gain 1 lore.
zh:
麥克老鴨傳家寶　當你打出這個物品時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到你一個具增幅的角色或地點下方。
戰歌　每當你一個下方有卡的角色或地點被挑戰時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: White Agony Plains - Golden Lagoon
en: PURE LIQUID GOLD This location gets +1 ◊ for each character here.
zh: 純液態黃金　這裡每有一個角色，這個地點就獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Ares - God of War
en:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
CALL TO BATTLE Once during your turn, whenever
you put a card under one of your characters or
locations, you may ready chosen character. If you do,
that character can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh:
魯莽（這個角色不能探險，且每回合若有能力必須挑戰。）
號召作戰　你回合中一次，每當你把一張卡放到你一個角色或地點下方時，你可以準備指定角色。若你這麼做，該角色本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Peter Pan - High Flyer
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Raksha - Fearless Mother
en:
ON PATROL Once during your turn, you may pay
1 ⬡ less to move this character to a location.
zh: 巡邏中　你回合中一次，你可以少支付 1 ⬡ 將這個角色移動到一個地點。

name: Rama - Vigilant Father
en:
PROTECTION OF THE PACK Whenever you play
another character with 5 ¤ or more, you may
ready this character. If you do, he can't quest for
the rest of this turn.
zh: 群體的守護　每當你打出另一個 5 ¤ 或以上的角色時，你可以準備這個角色。若你這麼做，他本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Mother Gothel - Underhanded Schemer
en:
SOMEBODY'S GOT TO USE IT If a character was
banished this turn, this character gets +2 ¤.
zh: 總得有人用它　若本回合有角色被消滅，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Hermes - Harried Messenger
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
zh: 突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

name: Beast - Aggressive Lord
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
THAT'S MINE Whenever he challenges another
character, if there's a card under this character, each
opponent loses 1 lore and you gain 1 lore.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
那是我的　每當他挑戰另一個角色時，若這個角色下方有卡，每位對手失去 1 點傳說值，你獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Bronx - Ferocious Beast
en:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your
hand, this character can't ready.
zh:
魯莽（這個角色不能探險，且每回合若有能力必須挑戰。）
白日化石　若你手上有 3 張或以上的卡，這個角色不能準備。

name: Tinker Bell - Temperamental Fairy
en:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Tinker Bell.)
HARMLESS DIVERSION When you play this
character, exert chosen opposing character with
2 ¤ or less.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Tinker Bell 的角色上。）
無害的干擾　當你打出這個角色時，橫置一個 2 ¤ 或以下的指定對方角色。

name: David Xanatos - Charismatic Leader
en:
LEARN FROM EVERYTHING During your turn,
whenever one of your characters is banished,
draw a card.
WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? Whenever this
character quests, chosen character gains Rush this
turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)
zh:
從一切中學習　在你的回合中，每當你一個角色被消滅時，抽一張牌。
你還在等什麼？　每當這個角色探險時，指定角色本回合獲得突襲。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

name: Hans - Brazen Manipulator
en:
JOSTLING FOR POWER King and Queen characters
can't quest.
GROWING INFLUENCE At the start of your turn,
if an opponent has 2 or more ready characters in
play, gain 2 lore.
zh:
爭奪權力　國王和皇后角色不能探險。
日益壯大的影響力　在你的回合開始時，若有對手有 2 個或以上已準備的角色在場，獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Hercules - Mighty Leader
en:
EVER VIGILANT This character can't be dealt
damage unless he's being challenged.
EVER VALIANT While this character is exerted,
your other Hero characters can't be dealt damage
unless they're being challenged.
zh:
永遠警惕　除非這個角色正被挑戰，否則他不能被造成傷害。
永遠英勇　當這個角色橫置時，除非你其他的英雄角色正被挑戰，否則他們不能被造成傷害。

name: Goliath - Guardian of Castle Wyvern
en:
BE CAREFUL, ALL OF YOU Whenever one of
your Gargoyle characters challenges another
character, gain 1 lore.
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your
hand, this character can't ready.
zh:
大家小心　每當你一個石像鬼角色挑戰另一個角色時，獲得 1 點傳說值。
白日化石　若你手上有 3 張或以上的卡，這個角色不能準備。

name: Brooklyn - Second in Command
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your
hand, this character can't ready.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
白日化石　若你手上有 3 張或以上的卡，這個角色不能準備。

name: Donald Duck - Ruby Champion
en:
HIGH ENERGY Your other Ruby characters
get +1 ¤.
POWERFUL REWARD Your other Ruby characters
with 7 ¤ or more get +1 ◊.
zh:
高能量　你其他的紅寶石角色獲得 +1 ¤。
強力獎勵　你其他 7 ¤ 或以上的紅寶石角色獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Elisa Maza - Intrepid Investigator
en:
SPECIAL DETAIL While you have 2 or more
other characters in play with 5 ¤ or more, this
character gets +2 ◊.
zh: 特殊任務　當你另有 2 個或以上 5 ¤ 或以上的角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Aladdin - Barreling Through
en:
Boost 1 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 1 ⬡ to put
the top card of your deck facedown under this character.)
Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge
each turn if able.)
ONLY THE BOLD While there's a card under this character,
your characters with Reckless gain “⟳ — Gain 1 lore.”
zh:
增幅 1 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
魯莽（這個角色不能探險，且每回合若有能力必須挑戰。）
唯有勇者　當這個角色下方有卡時，你具魯莽的角色獲得「⟳ — 獲得 1 點傳說值」。

name: Lady Tremaine - Sinister Socialite
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 ⬡ to put
the top card of your deck facedown under this character.)
EXPEDIENT SCHEMES Whenever this character quests,
if you've put a card under her this turn, you may play an
action with cost 5 or less from your discard for free, then
put that action card on the bottom of your deck instead of
into your discard.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
權宜之計　每當這個角色探險時，若你本回合把一張卡放到她下方，你可以從你的棄牌堆免費打出一個費用 5 或以下的行動，然後將該行動卡放到你牌庫底而非棄牌堆。

name: The Headless Horseman - Terror of Sleepy Hollow
en:
LEAVES NO TRACE When you play this character,
banish chosen opposing character with 2 ¤ or less.
GATHERING STRENGTH During your turn, whenever
an opposing character is banished, each of your
characters gets +1 ¤ this turn.
zh:
不留痕跡　當你打出這個角色時，消滅一個 2 ¤ 或以下的指定對方角色。
匯聚力量　在你的回合中，每當有對方角色被消滅時，你每個角色本回合獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Mulan - Standing Her Ground
en:
FLOWING BLADE During your turn, if you've put
a card under one of your characters or locations
this turn, this character takes no damage from
challenges.
zh: 流動之刃　在你的回合中，若你本回合把一張卡放到你一個角色或地點下方，這個角色不受挑戰的傷害。

name: Brom Bones - Burly Bully
en:
ROUGH AND TUMBLE Whenever this character
challenges a character with 2 ¤ or less, each
opponent loses 1 lore.
zh: 粗野蠻橫　每當這個角色挑戰一個 2 ¤ 或以下的角色時，每位對手失去 1 點傳說值。

name: Shere Khan - Fierce and Furious
en:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Shere Khan.)
WILD RAGE 1 ⬡, Deal 1 damage to this character —
Ready this character. He can't quest for the rest of
this turn.
zh:
變身 5 ⬡（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Shere Khan 的角色上。）
狂野暴怒　1 ⬡，對這個角色造成 1 點傷害 — 準備這個角色。他本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Next Stop, Olympus
en:
If you have a character with 5 ¤ or more in play, you
pay 2 ⬡ less to play this action.
Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the rest
of this turn. The next time they challenge another
character this turn, gain 1 lore.
zh:
若你有一個 5 ¤ 或以上的角色在場，你打出這個行動時少支付 2 ⬡。
準備指定角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。他們本回合下一次挑戰另一個角色時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Get to Safety!
en:
Play a location with cost 3 or less from your discard for
free. Then, if you have a location named Sleepy Hollow
in play, draw a card.
zh: 從你的棄牌堆免費打出一個費用 3 或以下的地點。然後，若你有一個名為 Sleepy Hollow 的地點在場，抽一張牌。

name: Time to Go!
en:
Banish chosen character of yours to draw 2 cards.
If that character had a card under them, draw 3
cards instead.
zh: 消滅你一個指定角色，來抽兩張牌。若該角色下方有卡，改為抽三張牌。

name: Ghostly Tale
en: Exert all opposing characters with 2 ¤ or less.
zh: 橫置所有 2 ¤ 或以下的對方角色。

name: Dragon Fire
en: Banish chosen character.
zh: 消滅指定角色。

name: Mushu's Rocket
en:
I NEED FIREPOWER When you play this item, chosen
character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge the
turn they're played.)
HITCH A RIDE 2 ⬡, Banish this item — Chosen
character gains Rush this turn.
zh:
我需要火力　當你打出這個物品時，指定角色本回合獲得突襲。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）
搭便車　2 ⬡，消滅這個物品 — 指定角色本回合獲得突襲。

name: The Bitterwood - Underground Forest
en:
GATHER RESOURCES Once during your turn, whenever you move a
character with 5 ¤ or more here, you may draw a card.
zh: 匯集資源　你回合中一次，每當你把一個 5 ¤ 或以上的角色移動到這裡時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Sleepy Hollow - The Bridge
en:
HEAD FOR THE BRIDGE! Whenever a character quests while here, you may
banish this location to gain 2 lore and give them Evasive until the start of
your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh: 衝向橋！　每當有角色在這裡探險時，你可以消滅這個地點來獲得 2 點傳說值，並給予他們迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Judy Hopps - On the Case
en:
HIDDEN CLUES When you play this character, if you
have another Detective character in play, you may
put chosen item into its player's inkwell facedown
and exerted.
zh: 隱藏線索　當你打出這個角色時，若你另有一個偵探角色在場，你可以將指定的物品牌面朝下並橫置放入其持有者的墨水池。

name: Hen Wen - Prophetic Pig
en:
FUTURE SIGHT Whenever this character quests,
look at the top card of your deck. Put it on either
the top or the bottom of your deck.
zh: 未來預視　每當這個角色探險時，查看你牌庫頂的卡。將它放到你牌庫頂或牌庫底。

name: Anna - Making Snow Plans
en:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
zh: 支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Daisy Duck - Ghost Finder
en:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may
add their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤
this turn.)
zh: 支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Cri-Kee - Good Luck Charm
en:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they had
Evasive.)

name: Rapunzel - Creative Captor
en:
ENSNARL When you play this character, chosen
opposing character gets -3 ¤ this turn.
zh: 纏繞　當你打出這個角色時，指定的對方角色本回合獲得 -3 ¤。

name: Fergus McDuck - Scrooge's Father
en:
TOUGHEN UP When you play this character,
chosen character of yours gains Ward until the
start of your next turn. (Opponents can't choose
them except to challenge.)
zh: 變得強韌　當你打出這個角色時，你一個指定角色獲得守護，直到你的下個回合開始。（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。）

name: Scuttle - Birdbrained
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except
to challenge.)
zh: 守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）

name: Ichabod Crane - Bookish Schoolmaster
en:
WELL-READ Whenever this character quests, if
you've played a character with cost 5 or more
this turn, put the top card of your deck into your
inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 博學　每當這個角色探險時，若你本回合打出過一個費用 5 或以上的角色，將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Jasmine - Soothing Princess
en:
Boost 2 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay
2 ⬡ to put the top card of your deck facedown
under this character.)
UPLIFTING AURA Whenever this character
quests, if there's a card under her, remove up to 3
damage from each of your characters.
zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
振奮氣場　每當這個角色探險時，若她下方有卡，從你每個角色身上移除至多 3 點傷害。

en:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Judy Hopps.)
LATERAL THINKING During your turn, your
Detective characters gain Alert and Resist +2.
(They can challenge as if they had Evasive.
Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
zh:
變身 4 ⬡（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Judy Hopps 的角色上。）
橫向思考　在你的回合中，你的偵探角色獲得警戒和抵抗 +2。（他們可以視同具迴避般挑戰。對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

name: Ichabod Crane - Scared Out of His Mind

you may put this card into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.

name: Scar - Eerily Prepared

zh:
增幅 2 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
適者生存　每當你把一張卡放到這個角色下方時，指定的對方角色本回合獲得 -5 ¤。

name: Daisy Duck - Paranormal Investigator
en:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Daisy Duck.)
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add
their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
STRANGE HAPPENINGS While this character is exerted,
cards enter opponents' inkwells exerted.
zh:
變身 4 ⬡（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Daisy Duck 的角色上。）
支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）
怪異事件　當這個角色橫置時，卡進入對手墨水池時是橫置的。

name: Cinderella - Dream Come True
en:
WHATEVER YOU WISH FOR At the end of your turn,
if you played a Princess character this turn, you
may put a card from your hand into your inkwell
facedown to draw a card.
zh: 你所願的一切　在你的回合結束時，若你本回合打出過一個公主角色，你可以將一張手牌牌面朝下放入你的墨水池，來抽一張牌。

name: Judy Hopps - Uncovering Clues
en:
THOROUGH INVESTIGATION When you play this
character and whenever she quests, look at
the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a
Detective character card and put it into your
hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in
any order.
zh: 徹底調查　當你打出這個角色以及每當她探險時，查看你牌庫頂 3 張卡。你可以展示一張偵探角色卡並加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Pluto - Clever Cluefinder
en:
ON THE TRAIL ⟳ — If you have a Detective character
in play, return an item card from your discard to your
hand. Otherwise, put it on the top of your deck.
zh: 循線追蹤　⟳ — 若你有一個偵探角色在場，將一張物品卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌；否則，將它放到你牌庫頂。

name: Daisy Duck - Sapphire Champion
en:
STAND FAST Your other Sapphire characters gain
Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

Sapphire characters quests, you may look at the
top card of your deck. Put it on either the top or
the bottom of your deck.
zh:
堅守　你其他的藍寶石角色獲得抵抗 +1。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）
向前看　每當你另一個藍寶石角色探險時，你可以查看你牌庫頂的卡。將它放到你牌庫頂或牌庫底。

name: Kristoff - Mining the Ruins

Boost 1 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 1 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
WORTH MINING Whenever this character quests,
if there's a card under him, put the top card of your
deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh:
增幅 1 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
值得開採　每當這個角色探險時，若他下方有卡，將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Mickey Mouse - Detective
en:
GET A CLUE When you play this character, you
may put the top card of your deck into your
inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 找到線索　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Hen Wen's Visions
en:
Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put 1 on the top
of your deck and the rest on the bottom in any order.
zh: 查看你牌庫頂 4 張卡。將 1 張放到你牌庫頂，其餘的以任意順序放到牌庫底。

name: Promising Lead
en:
Chosen character gets +1 ◊ and gains Support this turn.
(Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤ to another chosen
character's ¤ this turn.)
zh: 指定角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊ 並獲得支援。（每當他們探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Might Solve a Mystery
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal
up to 1 character card and up to 1 item card and put
them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of
your deck in any order.
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
查看你牌庫頂 4 張卡。你可以展示至多 1 張角色卡和至多 1 張物品卡並加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Sudden Scare
en:
Put chosen opposing character into their player's
inkwell facedown. That player puts the top card of
their deck into their inkwell facedown.
zh: 將指定的對方角色牌面朝下放入其持有者的墨水池。該玩家將其牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放入其墨水池。

name: Spooky Sight
en:
Put all characters with cost 3 or less into their players'
inkwells facedown and exerted.
zh: 將所有費用 3 或以下的角色牌面朝下並橫置放入其持有者的墨水池。

name: Detective's Badge
en:
PROTECT AND SERVE ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen character gains Resist +1
and the Detective classification until the start of your next turn.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
zh: 保護與服務　⟳，1 ⬡ — 指定角色獲得抵抗 +1 和偵探分類，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Ink Amplifier
en:
ENERGY CAPTURE Whenever an opponent draws a card
during their turn, if it's the second card they've drawn
this turn, you may put the top card of your deck into
your inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 能量捕捉　每當對手在其回合抽一張牌時，若那是他們本回合抽的第二張卡，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Fairy Godmother's Wand
en:
ONLY TILL MIDNIGHT During your turn, whenever you
put a card into your inkwell, chosen Princess character
of yours gains Ward until the start of your next turn.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
zh: 只到午夜　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，你一個指定的公主角色獲得守護，直到你的下個回合開始。（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。）

name: Inkrunner
en:
PREFLIGHT CHECK When you play this item, draw a card.
READY TO RIDE ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen character gains Alert
this turn. (They can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
zh:
飛行前檢查　當你打出這個物品時，抽一張牌。
準備上路　⟳，1 ⬡ — 指定角色本回合獲得警戒。（他們可以視同具迴避般挑戰。）

name: Castle of the Horned King - Bastion of Evil
en:
INTO THE GLOOM Once during your turn, whenever a character quests
while here, you may ready chosen item.
zh: 進入陰暗　你回合中一次，每當有角色在這裡探險時，你可以準備指定的物品。

name: Robin Hood - Ephemeral Archer
en:
Boost 1 ⬡ (Once during your turn, you may pay 1 ⬡
to put the top card of your deck facedown under this
character.)
EXPERT SHOT Whenever this character quests, if
there's a card under him, deal 1 damage to up to 2
chosen characters.
zh:
增幅 1 ⬡（你回合中一次，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放到這個角色下方。）
神射手　每當這個角色探險時，若他下方有卡，對至多 2 個指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Donald Duck - Ghost Hunter
en:
RAISE A RUCKUS When you play this character,
chosen Detective character gains Challenger +2
this turn. (They get +2 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 引起騷動　當你打出這個角色時，指定的偵探角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Goliath - Clan Leader
en:
DUSK TO DAWN At the end of each player's turn, if they
have more than 2 cards in their hand, they choose and
discard cards until they have 2. If they have fewer than 2
cards in their hand, they draw until they have 2.
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your hand,
this character can't ready.
zh:
日暮到黎明　在每位玩家的回合結束時，若他們手牌超過 2 張，選擇並棄牌直到手牌剩 2 張；若手牌少於 2 張，抽牌直到手牌有 2 張。
白日化石　若你手上有 3 張或以上的卡，這個角色不能準備。

name: The Headless Horseman - Cursed Rider
en:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named The Headless Horseman.)
WITCHING HOUR When you play this character, each
player draws 3 cards, then discards 3 cards at random.
Choose an opposing character and deal 2 damage to
them for each action card discarded this way.
zh:
變身 5 ⬡（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 The Headless Horseman 的角色上。）
巫術時刻　當你打出這個角色時，每位玩家抽 3 張牌，然後隨機棄掉 3 張。選擇一個對方角色，以此方式每棄掉一張行動卡，就對其造成 2 點傷害。

name: Clawhauser - Donut Detective
en:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
zh: 挑戰者 +2（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Francine - Eyeing the Evidence
en:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
zh: 抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）

name: Inspector Tezuka - Resolute Officer
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
zh: 護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）

name: Basil - Tenacious Mouse
en:
HOLD YOUR GROUND Whenever you play another
Detective character, this character gains Resist +1
until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to

準備指定角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。他們本回合下一次挑戰一個角色時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Judy Hopps - Lead Detective
en:
Shift 4 ⬡
LATERAL THINKING During your turn, your
Detective characters gain Alert and Resist +2.
zh:
變身 4 ⬡
橫向思考　在你的回合中，你的偵探角色獲得警戒和抵抗 +2。

name: Cinderella - Dream Come True
en:
WHATEVER YOU WISH FOR At the end of your
turn, if you played a Princess character this
turn, you may put a card from your hand into
your inkwell facedown to draw a card.
zh: 你所願的一切　在你的回合結束時，若你本回合打出過一個公主角色，你可以將一張手牌牌面朝下放入你的墨水池，來抽一張牌。

name: Spooky Sight
en:
Put all characters with cost 3 or less into their
players' inkwells facedown and exerted.
zh: 將所有費用 3 或以下的角色牌面朝下並橫置放入其持有者的墨水池。

name: Goliath - Clan Leader
en:
DUSK TO DAWN At the end of each player's turn, if they
have more than 2 cards in their hand, they choose and
discard cards until they have 2. If they have fewer than
2 cards in their hand, they draw until they have 2.
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your hand,
this character can't ready.
zh:
日暮到黎明　在每位玩家的回合結束時，若他們手牌超過 2 張，選擇並棄牌直到手牌剩 2 張；若手牌少於 2 張，抽牌直到手牌有 2 張。
白日化石　若你手上有 3 張或以上的卡，這個角色不能準備。

name: Nick Wilde - Persistent Investigator
en:
Shift 3 ⬡
CASE CLOSED During your turn, whenever one
of your Detective characters banishes another
character in a challenge, draw a card.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡
結案　在你的回合中，每當你一個偵探角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，抽一張牌。

name: The Sword of Hercules
en:
MIGHTY HIT When you play this item, banish
chosen opposing Deity character.
HAND-TO-HAND During your turn, whenever one
of your characters banishes another character in a
challenge, gain 1 lore.
zh:
強力一擊　當你打出這個物品時，消滅指定的對方神祇角色。
近身搏鬥　在你的回合中，每當你一個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Ariel - Ethereal Voice
en:
Boost 1 ⬡
COMMAND PERFORMANCE Once during your
turn, whenever you play a song, if there's a card
under this character, you may draw a card.
zh:
增幅 1 ⬡
命令演出　你回合中一次，每當你打出一首歌時，若這個角色下方有卡，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Hades - Looking for a Deal
en:
WHAT D'YA SAY? When you play this character,
you may choose an opposing character. If you do,
draw 2 cards unless that character's player puts
that card on the bottom of their deck.
zh: 你說呢？　當你打出這個角色時，你可以選擇一個對方角色。若你這麼做，抽兩張牌，除非該角色的持有者將該卡放到其牌庫底。
